anomalies.observed: The THT MCU symbol U2 (ATtiny45-20P) shows XTAL1/PB3 carrying net POT on pin 3 and XTAL2/PB4 carrying net TACH on pin 2.
anomalies.expected: On the ATtiny45 DIP-8/SOIC-8 package PB3 is pin 2 and PB4 is pin 3. The parallel ATtiny13 footprint U3 in the same schematic correctly shows PB3 = pin 2 (POT) and PB4 = pin 3 (TACH), confirming the two footprints for the same signals must not disagree.

evidence.quote: Sheet 1: U2 ATtiny45-20P ... XTAL1/PB3 -> 3 -> POT, XTAL2/PB4 -> 2 -> TACH
Sheet 1: U3 ATtiny13V-10S ... PB3 -> 2 -> POT, PB4 -> 3 -> TACH

anomalies.impact: If the THT ATtiny45 (U2) is populated, POT and TACH are routed to the opposite package pins, so the ADC would sample the tachometer signal on the pot input and vice versa; the fan speed would no longer track the potentiometer.

parsed.summary: The design is largely consistent with an ATtiny fan controller, but the two alternative MCU footprints disagree: U2 (ATtiny45-20P) assigns PB3/PB4 to pins 3/2 while U3 (ATtiny13V-10S) and the device pinout use pins 2/3, so POT and TACH would be swapped on the THT variant.
